name: io.github.roundhouseai-io/ioi-mcp
title: ioi
description: Pay-per-call open-model inference. USDC on Base over x402, or an API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional API key as a Bearer token: Bearer sk-canary-…. Omit it to pay per call with x402 (the host must sign _meta["x402/payment"]; otherwise use the npm package).

environmentVariables.name: IOI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional sk-canary-… key. When set, calls use Authorization: Bearer and do not sign x402 payments.

environmentVariables.name: IOI_MAX_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Most USDC one call may sign, as a decimal. Default 0.05, or the user's rh-x402 limits.maxPerCall when they set one.

environmentVariables.name: IOI_DAILY_CAP
environmentVariables.description: Most USDC signed per UTC day. Default 5, or the user's rh-x402 limits.dailyCap when they set one.

environmentVariables.name: IOI_MAX_DEPOSIT
environmentVariables.description: Most USDC a batch-settlement channel may deposit. Default 1. A larger quote is refused and nothing is signed.

environmentVariables.name: IOI_SCHEME
environmentVariables.description: Force exact, upto, or batch-settlement. Unset prefers upto, then exact. batch-settlement is also used when an open ~/.x402 channel already covers the quote.
